text: ITEM 1 | Roasted broccoli florets, dark green with yellow-green tips and patchy darker brown-green spots, some edges looking slightly browned or charred. Florets are bite-sized, about 2-3 cm across, with bumpy, tightly clustered buds and short pale stems. They sit in a loose heap in the center-right of the plate, with no visible sauce, oil pooling, or other food beside them. | 120
